description: FREE (rate-limited) — find a person: name, job title, company, location, LinkedIn profile, how sure. Give first_name + last_name + company (or domain), a LinkedIn URL, a work e-mail, or a question in `query` ("CFO of Tink in Berlin"). No e-mail or phone in the answer — those are enrich_records.

domain.description: The company's domain, e.g. acme.com (more exact than the name)

eu_only.description: Only services in the EU (skips one US web index)

name.description: Full name, when there is no split

query.description: A question in plain words, e.g. "CFO of Tink in Berlin"

name: find_person
title: Find a person
